name: Autumn's end
source:
A doomed lesbian love story between 2 dog girls.


Cinnamon an obsessive, mentally ill cocker spaniel and painting student. She's consumed with the idea that Rowan is the only one she needs in order to die happy.

Rowan is a charismatic punk shi-tzu fashion student that is everything Cinnamon wants to be.


From the moment Cinnamon lays eyes on Rowan... Cinnamon knows she's found her purpose. A purpose she's been looking for for countless days and nights. She's obsessed- she needs to spend every waking moment with this girl... just to make her feel okay.

... And if things don't go the way she wants them to...


...Everything comes crashing down, harder, harder, and harder.

[Edited from [url=https://countlessbathory.itch.io/autumns-end-demo]itch.io[/url]]
